developers,
in JavaScript and in Python, and in a couple
of other programming languages as well,
you don't have to wrap everything into a
class as you, for example, have to do it in
Java. That's why you will see standalone

without any classes in all these examples
throughout the course. In Java or C#,
these would simply be some methods defined
in some root main class, you could say. So
that's just something to be aware of. You
simply don't need to have classes around
everything in programming languages like
Python or JavaScript.
